xterm.js — vendored real terminal emulator (Anchor R&D interactive terminal)
============================================================================

WHAT THIS IS
  xterm.js + xterm.css are the genuine, upstream xterm.js terminal emulator,
  vendored as plain static assets (exactly like the vendored KaTeX bundle).
  xterm.js is pure browser JavaScript with NO native/compiled component — the
  shipped library is a single UMD bundle (xterm.js) plus a stylesheet
  (xterm.css). This satisfies Anchor's stdlib-only / no-native-assets rule the
  same way KaTeX does.

  These files provide the real terminal CANVAS/DOM renderer (the `Terminal`
  class, exposed as `window.Terminal` by the UMD bundle). The Anchor REPL chrome
  (command input handling, inline gates / AskUserQuestion, the
  exit -> discover -> confirm-adopt panel, and the best-effort reap on unload)
  is layered ON TOP of this by vendor/anchor-term/anchor-term.js, which adapts
  the Anchor SSE stream into `term.write()` and captures `term.onData()` input.
  The public mount API (window.AnchorTerm.mount) is UNCHANGED, so callers and
  tests need no rewrite of the integration surface.

SOURCE
  Package : @xterm/xterm (the current scoped package name for xterm.js)
  Version : 6.0.0
  Copied  : 2026-06-11 from a local, OFFLINE node_modules tree on this machine
            (no network access; the gate has no internet):

   install at %LOCALAPPDATA%\Programs\Microsoft VS Code\...\resources\app\
   node_modules\@xterm\xterm — used here only as corroboration of availability.)

FILES
  xterm.js   — the upstream UMD bundle (defines window.Terminal). The trailing
               `//# sourceMappingURL=xterm.js.map` comment was stripped because
               the .map is not vendored (it would 404 harmlessly otherwise).
  xterm.css  — the upstream stylesheet for the terminal viewport/scrollbar.
  LICENSE    — the upstream MIT license (xterm.js authors / SourceLair / chjj).

SERVED AT
  /vendor/xterm/xterm.js
  /vendor/xterm/xterm.css
  (read-only static route in anchor_gui.py, path-traversal safe, mirroring the
   vendored-KaTeX and anchor-term static-asset patterns.)

LICENSE
